question: Related Questions Q. My friend has asked the following question: Can anyone enlighten me on this please... answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46391 Country: India Title: Tarawih Salah for Women Question: Please give me fatwa about tarawih namaz for women. Whether women can pray tarawih on separate place in the masjid behind imam jamah? Please give answer for Shafi and Hanafi separately? Answer ID: 46391 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 995/777/H=1434) Islamic Shariah does not command the women to go to mosque and offer tarawih salah behind imam; \rather they should arrange for tarawih in their homes like the five times of salah. It is makrooh tahrimi for women to visit the mosque. It is so mentioned in Fatawa Shami etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
